newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rally as interest rates remain unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rally as interest rates remain unchanged.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite closed higher for the third straight session on Wednesday, led by strong advances in computer networking stocks.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 9.87 to 1373.75. Winners strode past losers by a margin of more than 11 to ten on volume of more than 664 million shares.
Networking stocks were broadly higher, with 3Com Corp rising 2-5/8 to 41-5/8, Cisco Systems adding 1-3/8 to 65-3/4, Ascend Communications Inc up 1-1/2 to 51-1/2.
"The momentum guys were getting back into the network stocks again," said Patrick Davis, head of OTC trading at Salomon Brothers.
Dell Computer shot up 7-1/8 to 106-3/4 after reporting stronger than expected earnings on Tuesday after the market close.
CKS Group Inc rose three to 26-1/2 after Goldman Sachs added the stock to its recommended list.
Shares of Consilium jumped one to 3-9/16 after Hambrecht & Quist raised their rating on the stock.
The broader Russell 2000 was up 1.86 to 370.06.
